description: This file contains unit tests for validating XML configuration files related to the OpenMRS module, specifically testing version compatibility and configuration validity.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_3
classes.description: Contains parameterized unit tests to ensure proper validation and compatibility of configuration XMLs for different OpenMRS versions.

methods.name: validXmlWhenMandatoryIsSet
methods.description: Tests that a minimal configuration XML with the 'mandatory' flag set to true is valid for supported versions.

methods.name: validXmlWhenMandatoryIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that a minimal configuration XML without explicitly setting the 'mandatory' flag is valid for supported versions.

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides a stream of supported version arguments for parameterized tests.
